objects.name: Analytic 2175
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a host simultaneously maintaining an inbound connection on an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port and an outbound connection to a destination outside the ICS network zone, detectable as correlated dual flows with matching timing and approximate byte-count proportionality. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: IPFIX/NetFlow flow record (src/dst IP, src/dst port, protocol, packets/bytes/time): host maintains simultaneous flows to device subnet and external destination with timing/byte-count correlation indicating relay

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window and byte-count proportionality tolerance used to determine whether concurrent flows represent a relay pattern.
